_README: Verbatim customer reviews only. Never invent, paraphrase, embellish or compose a review — fabricated testimonials are an FTC violation and this file is the one place someone would be tempted. Every entry here was read off the shop's Google Business Profile and copied exactly, typos included. These are the BUILD-TIME fallback: they are server-rendered into the page so the section is never empty, and main.ts replaces them at runtime with the current five-star reviews from the live Google feed. If the feed is down, unreachable or returns too few reviews, these stay up. featurableId is the widget id from featurable.com, which reads the shop's own Google Business Profile with the owner's authorisation. Null disables the live feed cleanly and leaves these three showing.
